//: Marketplace-scan reproduction. The developer-dashboard preview scan type-checks with only production dependencies installed (no @types/node) and honors this project's tsconfig lib. That environment turns any method missing from the declared lib, or any node global, into `any`, which the scorecard then reports as no-unsafe-* warnings. This config reproduces that view locally and in CI: `types: []` drops the @types packages the scan does not install, while `obsidian` (its own types) and the local .d.ts files still resolve. It runs over shipped source only; __tests__ and __mocks__ are Jest-only and never reach the bundle. Wired into `npm run lint` so the gap is caught before a release, not after the scan.
